title: Unmarked Landfall source construction record

sources.title: Wheredle
used_for: map commitment after visual clue gathering

construction: An original fictional-country survey replaces real Street View, real geography, map tiles, and source imagery with deterministic Canvas and SVG artwork. Seeded province conventions, paged reference plates, a branching local road graph, and route-memory localization turn geolocation into a self-contained interaction and reasoning task.
license_note: No third-party image, map, audio, code, font, or other presentation asset is bundled. All visible artwork is rendered from repository-authored Canvas, SVG, HTML, and CSS primitives.
